", "explanation": "The `TopRate.png` background image conveys meaningful, text-bearing information (likely \"Top Rate\"). Since background images are ignored by assistive technologies, this information was previously inaccessible. By adding a `` element with the text \"Top Rate: \" and applying a `visually-hidden` class (which would need to be defined in CSS to hide the text visually), the essential information is now available to screen readers and other assistive technologies, satisfying WCAG 1.1.1 without altering the visual presentation for sighted users.", "effort": "low" } ```

```json { "fixedHtml": "

\n \n Include Signature\n \n

", "explanation": "The `span` element was modified to expose its role and state to assistive technologies. `role=\"checkbox\"` was added to identify it as a checkbox. `aria-checked=\"false\"` was added to indicate its initial unchecked state (this attribute should be toggled by the `toggleCheckbox` function). `tabindex=\"0\"` was added to make the custom control focusable via keyboard, which is essential for interactive elements. The `id` was moved from the `img` to the `span` to correctly identify the interactive checkbox component itself, aligning with the `onclick` handler's parameter. The `alt` attribute on the image was kept empty as the `span` now provides the accessible name and state.", "effort": "low" } ```

```json { "fixedHtml": "\n \n\nFootball Scoreboard", "explanation": "The 'alt' attribute of the image within the first link was updated from an empty string to 'Football Scoreboard'. This provides a meaningful accessible name for the image link, allowing screen readers to clearly announce its purpose and resolving the WCAG 2.4.4 violation. The chosen 'alt' text aligns with the purpose of the adjacent text link, ensuring consistency and clarity for all users.", "effort": "low" } ```
